brief: Four-storey Richardsonian Romanesque opera house of 1890: a rough-hewn stone front with a row of big arched windows on the top floor, a corbelled cornice with finials, brick side walls, shopfronts on the ground floor and a projecting marquee over the theatre entrance.

facade.notes: the Sorg Opera House (Middletown OH, 1890): a four-storey rough-faced stone Romanesque front with a top row of big arches, a corbelled cornice, a vertical blade sign and a marquee over the entry; the side wall is bare buff brick with a ghost sign, exposed by a demolished neighbour -- now a lot and lawn

why.note: the 1880s-90s town opera house: a hall over shops, financed by a local industrialist
a party wall left bare when the neighbour came down
